top_jobs.title: AI Engineer
top_jobs.description:
The role

You build and ship across AI agents and client-facing systems, owning features end to end and shaping what gets built together with the client team. This is a hands-on delivery role on live problems, not a research seat. Projects typically start as a proposal, followed by a proof of concept, expand into a beta, then shipped to production. You'll be involved across the full arc, and you won't be doing it alone.</
